## Your 50 skills by category

You have more than 40 skills, so each category below shows its count and its three most useful commands. Ask for any category and I'll list all of it.

**Code review & quality (7)**
- `/code-reviewer`: reviews PRs, diffs or snippets and gives a merge verdict
- `/systematic-debugging`: finds a bug's cause before proposing any fix
- `/test-driven-development`: writes the tests first for a feature or bugfix

**Planning & dev workflow (6)**
- `/brainstorming`: shapes an idea before building anything new
- `/writing-plans`: turns a spec into a multi-step implementation plan
- `/changelog-generator`: turns git commits into user-facing release notes

**Writing (6)**
- `/content-production`: writes a blog post or article, from research through SEO
- `/copywriting`: headlines, taglines, CTAs and landing-page copy, with headline scoring
- `/doc-coauthoring`: a step-by-step process for co-writing specs, proposals and docs

**Web pages (5)**
- `/landing`: a premium single-file HTML landing page with GSAP and parallax
- `/landing-page-generator`: a Next.js and Tailwind landing page component
- `/page-cro`: audits a page that doesn't convert and ranks the fixes

**Vercel & web apps (5)**
- `/deploy-to-vercel`: deploys an app to Vercel and returns the live link
- `/vercel-optimize`: cuts cost and fixes slow routes on Vercel projects
- `/webapp-testing`: tests local web apps in a browser with Playwright

**Documents & office files (4)**
- `/docx`: creates or edits Word documents
- `/pptx`: creates or edits slide decks
- `/xlsx`: creates, cleans or edits spreadsheets and CSVs

**AI & agent building (4)**
- `/claude-api`: reference for the Claude API: models, pricing, tool use, caching
- `/mcp-builder`: builds MCP servers that connect LLMs to external services
- `/skill-creator`: creates, improves and benchmarks skills

**Data & finance (4)**
- `/data-quality-auditor`: profiles a dataset for missing values and outliers
- `/stock-analysis`: researches and values a listed stock or company
- `/financial-health`: ratio analysis, DCF valuation, budget variance and forecasts

**Media & images (4)**
- `/image-enhancer`: sharpens screenshots and images and raises their resolution
- `/slack-gif-creator`: makes animated GIFs sized for Slack
- `/algorithmic-art`: generative art in p5.js with seeded randomness

**Everyday utilities (3)**
- `/file-organizer`: tidies folders and finds duplicate files
- `/meeting-insights-analyzer`: finds communication patterns in meeting transcripts
- `/raffle-winner-picker`: picks fair random winners from a list

**Privacy law (2)**
- `/gdpr-compliance`: GDPR audits, privacy policies, DPAs and compliance answers
- `/dpdpa`: compliance advice on India's DPDP Act 2023

None of your skills are installed in more than one place.
